runtime: Standalone Luau; cached live client when accessible, independent multiplayer snapshot observer otherwise

verification.independent_multiplayer_mirror_parity: Offline synthetic packets: ownership, flags, owner stats, structures, attacks and four construction prices match uploaded GameState/Rules
verification.naval_and_diplomacy_contracts: Offline parity with supplied original Protocol, WorldMap, GameState and Rules: boat/build-warship/move/ally-request/ally-break encoding; water connectivity, unit paths/health, traitor flags and warship prices

network_fallback_scope: Multiplayer spawn, land combat/expansion, recall, alliance requests/replies/conditional breaks, city/factory/port/defense, transports, warship construction and patrol movement; no offensive weapons or SAM/silo state
strategy: Bounded spawn scoring, economic building setbacks, observed hostility memory, terrain/defense-cost forecasts, nearby coalition risk, recruitment reserves and one active enemy front
match_report: RoWorld_Match_Report.json, local only when executor writefile exists, every 30 seconds and on stop/observed match end; last 64 orders and current-snapshot metrics
